table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Item.customicode,
	Itemname= Item.name,
	currlistrow   = 0,
	stock         = 0.0000,
	packingdesc=Item.packingdesc,
	IntimationCode=ExpiryIntimationDetail.IntimationCode,
	icode=ExpiryIntimationDetail.icode,
	batch=ExpiryIntimationDetail.batch,
	expiry=ExpiryIntimationDetail.expiry,
	packunits=ExpiryIntimationDetail.packunits,
	packprice=ExpiryIntimationDetail.packprice,
	price=ExpiryIntimationDetail.price,
	ExpiryIntimationDetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	Itemcode = 0,
	invoicecode = ExpiryIntimationDetail.invoicecode,
	invoicedate = ExpiryIntimationDetail.invoicedate,
	ManfCode=CASE WHEN ExpiryIntimationDetail.ManfCode IS NULL THEN Item.ManfCode ELSE ExpiryIntimationDetail.ManfCode END,
	LastAccCode=ExpiryIntimationDetail.LastAccCode,
	refno = ExpiryIntimationDetail.refno,
	refdate = ExpiryIntimationDetail.refdate,
	qty = ExpiryIntimationDetail.qty
FROM  ExpiryIntimationDetail, Item 
WHERE 
	dbo.ExpiryIntimationDetail.IntimationCode = :ai_Code AND
	ExpiryIntimationDetail.icode = Item.icode
ORDER BY 
	ExpiryIntimationDetail.IDENTITYCOL
